description.value: Mountain High Pizza is a pizza restaurant set inside the Hearthstone Lodge at the centre of Sun Peaks Village, a four-season mountain resort community. The menu spans original, specialty, and premium pies alongside a build-your-own option, with vegetarian selections and gluten-free crusts available. Sixteen indoor seats and seventeen outdoor patio seats, combined with online ordering and delivery, make it a flexible refuelling option for cyclists passing through the village.

raw_osm.name: Mountain High Pizza
raw_osm.note: Opening hours were signed as "open 11AM to late"

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms an active pizza restaurant in Sun Peaks Village's Hearthstone Lodge, with phone number 250-578-7272 matching the OSM tag. Multiple menu items are explicitly labeled 'vegetarian' and a gluten-free crust option is listed across all pizza sizes; the 'Order Online' feature and delivery mention confirm takeout availability. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities was found in either the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Street address '3170 Creekside Way' is not explicitly stated on the website, which describes the location only as 'Hearthstone Lodge in the Centre of Sun Peaks Village' — OSM street address cannot be confirmed from website content alone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza restaurant confirmed active via website, located in the heart of Sun Peaks Village; a natural meal stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labeled 'vegetarian' (Greek Spillway, Veggie Grannie Greene's, Garlic Pesto Intimidator, Sweet and Spicy Pesto Veggie Showboat); gluten-free crust option listed across all pizza size tiers. No explicit vegan labeling found
